q: The full arc summaries, core beats and sub-arcs are coming.
detail: Viraena holds complete summaries, core beats and sub-arc breakdowns for the whole run and will bring them through. Until then most arcs carry a name, a roster and a handful of confirmed beats, and several carry nothing but the roster. Arcs 3, 4 and 7 have now been given directly and are marked as such; everything else in the events lists came from the master index and should be treated as provisional against her ledger. Arc 4's James and Ragnar tension line is the specific one to check first — it was not in her ruling and Arc 4 is supposed to be one thing only.
